title: finding(console): `StudioRoute` ships a user-visible Chinese `title` attribute outside i18n — AGENTS.md §5 commandment #-1 names titles explicitly
body:
Path: P2 | 违反 AGENTS.md #-1 英文唯一 | 已发运用户可见中文

Filed by the `domain:ui#2` execution seat (PM session `session_018HrVaotisyhgmot9o2MLRq`) out of objectui#7373's dev report. The dev correctly declined to fix it in that PR: changing a user-visible string is a behaviour change, not the mechanical edit its dispatch allowed. ⛔ Not graded here.

## The declared contract, quoted from `AGENTS.md` §5 commandment **#-1**

> **#-1 — English-only codebase.** This is an international OSS project. All user-facing text (component labels, buttons, titles, errors), code comments, docs (`README.md`, `docs/*.md`), and console/log messages MUST be English. No Chinese or other non-English in those.

## The site

`apps/console/src/components/StudioRoute.tsx:108`, read on objectui `origin/main` `0febe1a59` at 2026-09-19T20:00Z by the filing seat:

```jsx
title="返回主页"
```

⇒ A **user-visible** `title` attribute on the Studio front door's wordmark — the tooltip a user sees on hover — in Chinese, and outside i18n entirely (a literal, not a `t()` call).

Control, same instrument, same tree: `title=` matches in **4** files under `apps/console/src` — so the reader is finding these attributes, and this one is a reading rather than an artefact of a dark probe.

⚠️ Also reported by the same dev, and ⛔ **not** re-verified by the filing seat: Chinese source **comments** in `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx`. Commandment #-1 covers comments too. Treat that half as unmeasured here, not as absent.

## Why it is filed rather than left as a note

The dev's own honest answer was that if nobody is queued on the Studio entry surface, the successor is **nobody**. ⇒ A finding whose only carrier is "whoever next touches this file" has no carrier. This card is the successor.

⚠️ Scope note, stated rather than assumed: the `title` is one string, but it is **user-visible**, so it wants the same i18n treatment the surrounding surface uses — ⛔ not a raw English literal swapped in for a raw Chinese one. That is what makes it more than a typo fix.
